messages:
anna: Quick report: onboarding sampleapp saw mixed embedding lengths in one /embeddings response (512 vs 256) when token refresh + retry happens mid-batch. Rerank downstream produced bad scores.
mike: Which SDK / language? Repro steps?
anna: Node sampleapp using axios + http.Agent keepAlive. Repro: send batch of 8, expire token after first chunk, let SDK refresh and retry. Sometimes one embedding in data array is 256 long while others 512.
olga: That looks like stream interleaving or leftover bytes from previous response on pooled socket. SDK should validate dims and fail the batch. Server should also detect inconsistent lengths per-response.
mike: Short-term fixes: 1) SDK validate embedding length == expected_dim and raise EmbeddingShapeError. 2) On auth-refresh retry, force connection teardown (Agent.keepAlive=false) so socket isn't reused. 3) Add metric "mixed_embedding_size".
anna: Raw response (dims-only): {"data":[{"id":0,"len":512},{"id":1,"len":256},{"id":2,"len":512}],"model":"redwood-embed-1"}
olga: Filing runtime issue to validate per-response embedding dims and return an error when inconsistent. Also will add docs blurb in onboarding Troubleshooting.
mike: I'll open node-sdk PR to add shape check + set keepAlive=false on retry path. Will include unit test that simulates 401 mid-stream.
ci-bot: CI queued for node-sdk/patch-shape-guard (#410) job 10021
anna: Ran local e2e with token expiry injected: before patch saw intermittent mixed-dim returns; after SDK shape guard + disable reuse on retry, shape mismatches are surfaced as errors and no polluted vectors delivered.
olga: Good. We'll track runtime fix separately and update docs. Thanks team. :tada:
